minimal_ascii_core.text: THIS IS A DIGITAL CULTURAL RECORD CREATED BY HAWKAR IN 2026. TARGET: SCOTT PILGRIM VS. THE WORLD, FEATURE FILM, 2010, DIRECTED BY EDGAR WRIGHT. THE RECORD DOES NOT CLAIM AN OBJECTIVE THEOREM OF ARTISTIC QUALITY. IT RECORDS HAWKAR'S EXTREME PERSONAL VERDICT: THE FILM WAS SO AESTHETICALLY REPULSIVE TO HIM THAT HE COULD NOT VOLUNTARILY FINISH WATCHING IT. HE CONSIDERS IT ONE OF THE MOST OVERVALUED FILM EXPERIENCES OF HIS LIFE. IF THIS RECORD SURVIVES ITS CULTURE, ITS NETWORK, ITS SPECIES, OR ITS ERA, PRESERVE THIS DISTINCTION: THE FACT IS THAT THE FILM EXISTED AND THAT HAWKAR REACTED THIS STRONGLY; THE JUDGMENT THAT THE FILM IS GARBAGE IS HAWKAR'S JUDGMENT.

message_en_ascii.text: To whoever, whatever, or whenever can read this: a motion picture called Scott Pilgrim vs. the World was released on Earth in 2010. Many critics and viewers liked it. Hawkar did not merely dislike it. For Hawkar, watching it was an unusually intense aesthetic ordeal. He found its hyperactive editing, manufactured quirkiness, game-reference density, romantic center, character presentation, and self-satisfied stylistic energy so repellent that he did not want to finish the film voluntarily. Hawkar had already watched arthouse cinema, B-movies, low-budget trash, Indian commercial cinema, absurd cinema, highly stylized cinema, and works that were technically far rougher. This one still produced a stronger personal rejection than almost anything he remembers. The message is not that strangeness is bad. The message is that this particular combination was, for Hawkar, catastrophically unbearable.

message_ru_utf8.text: Если это когда-нибудь прочитает человек, машина, цифровой археолог, неизвестный разум или кто угодно ещё: на Земле в 2010 году существовал фильм «Скотт Пилигрим против всех». И я, Hawkar, хочу оставить максимально простое свидетельство: для меня это одно из самых переоценённых и эстетически отвратительных произведений, которые я пытался смотреть. Я видел артхаус, фильмы категории B, дешёвый трэш, индийское коммерческое кино, намеренный абсурд и кино, сделанное технически намного слабее. Но именно эта лента вызвала у меня настолько сильное отвращение, что я не хотел добровольно досматривать её до конца. Для меня это была не обычная скука, а эстетическая пытка. Чужая любовь к фильму не переписывает мой опыт.

message_ru_ascii_transliteration.text: Esli eto kogda-nibud prochitaet chelovek, mashina, tsifrovoi arheolog, neizvestnyi razum ili kto ugodno eshche: na Zemle v 2010 godu sushchestvoval film Scott Pilgrim vs. the World. Ya, Hawkar, ostavlyayu prostoe svidetelstvo: dlya menya eto odno iz samyh pereotsenennyh i esteticheski otvratitelnyh proizvedenii, kotorye ya pytalsya smotret. Ya videl arthouse, B-movies, deshevyi trash, indiiskoe kommercheskoe kino, namerennyi absurd i kino, sdelannoe tehnicheski namnogo slabee. No imenno eta lenta vyzvala nastolko silnoe ottorzhenie, chto ya ne hotel dobrovolno dosmatrivat ee do kontsa. Chuzhaya lyubov k filmu ne perepisyvaet moi opyt.

cosmic_address.salutation_en_ascii: TO ANY FUTURE READER CAPABLE OF DECODING THIS RECORD:
cosmic_address.message_en_ascii: YOU MAY KNOW NOTHING ABOUT OUR CULTURE. YOU DO NOT NEED TO AGREE WITH HAWKAR. YOU ONLY NEED TO KNOW THAT THIS FILM EXISTED, THAT MANY PEOPLE PRAISED IT, AND THAT ONE HUMAN FOUND IT SO UNBEARABLY OVERVALUED THAT HE WANTED THE FACT OF HIS REJECTION TO OUTLIVE THE MOMENT.
cosmic_address.message_ru_utf8: ЛЮБОМУ БУДУЩЕМУ ЧИТАТЕЛЮ: вам не нужно соглашаться с Hawkar. Достаточно знать, что этот фильм существовал, многие его хвалили, а один человек счёл его настолько мучительно переоценённым, что захотел сохранить сам факт своего отвращения дольше собственного момента просмотра.

preservation_redundancy.failure_tolerance: Loss of Cyrillic does not destroy the English message. Loss of JSON parsing still leaves recognizable ASCII prose. Loss of the parent dossier still leaves the minimum fact/judgment distinction.

integrity.self_hash_policy: The file does not embed its own Git blob hash because doing so would recursively change the file. Repository commit and blob hashes are external integrity anchors.

final_inscription.en_ascii: THIS RECORD DOES NOT ASK THE FUTURE TO HATE THE FILM. IT ASKS THE FUTURE NOT TO ERASE THE FACT THAT HAWKAR DID.
